data.name: Moutiq
data.gender_notes: Moutiq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is in pursuit of knowledge and truth. Derived from the Arabic root ‘awtq’, which means ‘to seek’. In Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) encouraged continuous learning and exploration of the divine word. The name Moutiq carries the meaning “Seeker, Explorer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Moutiq usually hope their child will grow to embody seeker, explorer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May Allah guide and inspire you on your journey of knowledge and righteousness.
data.etymology: Moutiq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Seeker, Explorer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Moutiq total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: موتق
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الفعل وتیق یعني من یتیق به و یوثق
in_arabic.long_meaning: الموتق هو اسم من أصل عربي مشتق من الفعل وتیق، وهو يعني الشخص الذي يوثق به و يتيقن بقدرته، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني الثقة و الاطمئنان في اللغة العربية و الذی یرد في بعض المواضع في القرآن الكريم كصفة للمتقين

in_urdu.name: موتیق
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جس پر بھروسہ کیا جائے اور قابل اعتماد ہو
in_urdu.long_meaning: موتیق ایک عربی मूल کا نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جس پر بھروسہ کیا جائے، قابل اعتماد اور وثوق کا حامل، یہ نام عربی زبان میں ثقة اور یقین کے مفہوم سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا استعمال ایک قابل ستائش نام کے طور پر کیا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: मौतिक
in_hindi.meaning: जिस पर भरोसा किया जा सके, विश्वासपात्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: मौतिक एक अरबी मूल का नाम है जिसका अर्थ है जिस पर भरोसा किया जा सके, यह नाम विश्वसनीयता और भरोसे के गुण को दर्शाता है, जो इस्लामी नामकरण परंपरा में एक महत्वपूर्ण पहलू है, यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए चुना जाता है जिन पर विश्वास किया जा सके

in_pashto.name: موتیق
in_pashto.meaning: داسي کسے چې پرې یې باوري وي او منل شوي

in_english.name: Moutiq
in_english.long_meaning: Moutiq is an Arabic-originated name meaning a person on whom one can rely, trustworthy and dependable, derived from the Arabic root 'w-th-q' which signifies trust, faith, and reliability, reflecting a personality trait of being someone with whom others can feel secure and confident

data.cultural_impact: The name "Moutiq" is a reminder of the Islamic emphasis on the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. Throughout Islamic history, scholars and intellectuals have contributed significantly to various fields of study, including mathematics, engineering, medicine, philosophy, literature, and natural sciences. Unlike other ancient civilizations, Islamic scholars were open to the incorporation of new knowledge from other cultures and traditions, leading to an intellectual exchange that enriched the Islamic world.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Moutiq" also carries profound spiritual significance in the Islamic faith. In the Quran, Allah (God) says, "O you who believe! Seek knowledge by that which Allah hath given you, the faculties of understanding and the intellect (Al Imran, 102)." This verse underscores the importance of intellectual endeavor and reflection in the pursuit of the Divine guidance and, ultimately, the attainment of spiritual enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Seeker, Explorer" symbolizes One who is in pursuit of knowledge and truth. Derived from the Arabic root ‘awtq’, which means ‘to seek’. In Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) encouraged continuous learning and exploration of the divine word.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Moutiq serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of seeker, explorer.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Battuta visited Moutiq during his travels in the 14th century. He described it as a major trading center and a significant Islamic cultural center.
Moutiq was the capital city of the Fatimid Caliphate from 969 to 1171 AD. It was a center of Islamic learning and scholarship during this period.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Moutiq' has seen a resurgence in modern context due to its rich history and cultural significance in Islamic art, Middle Eastern culture, and historic architecture. On Instagram, users share stunning images of Moutiq architecture, showcasing its intricate details and unique designs. Pinterest boards dedicated to Islamic art often feature Moutiq as a key element, inspiring home decor and interior design trends. Reddit threads discuss the historical significance of Moutiq and its role in Islamic history. These platforms have helped keep the name and its associated cultural traditions alive and relevant in modern society.
